Name: Dwight Moody
Summary: American evangelist, a former shoe salesman with little formal schooling, whose campaigns drew enormous crowds in Chicago, London, and beyond, and whose schools and publishing work outlived him.
Contribution: Brought mass urban evangelism to America and Britain, founded Moody Bible Institute, and made the inquiry room a staple of evangelistic campaigns.
Testimony: He testified to a simple Gospel, summed in John 3:16, preached plainly to whoever would listen.
